items.title: Zyada public unis mein tuition nahi
items.detail: Lekin har semester ek semester contribution dena padta hai.

items.title: Kuch jagah fees hai
items.detail: Kuch states aur universities non-EU students se tuition leti hain. Pehle check karo.

items.title: Rehne ka kharcha apna
items.detail: Rent, khaana, insurance. Visa ke liye funds ka proof bhi dikhana padta hai.

items.title: German aati ho toh plus
items.detail: Kai courses English mein hain, par German aane se rozmarra aasaan hota hai.

youtube.title: Germany mein free padhai? Poora sach
youtube.description:
Germany ki zyada public universities mein tuition fee nahi hoti, lekin semester contribution, rehne ka kharcha aur visa ke liye funds ka proof sab aapka. Kuch states aur universities non-EU students se fees bhi leti hain.

Free ka matlab zero kharcha nahi.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. Contact aap karoge, hum nahi.
